instruction: How to restart ArgoCD repo-server
output: kubectl rollout restart deployment argocd-repo-server -n argocd

instruction: How to restart ArgoCD application controller
output: kubectl rollout restart deployment argocd-application-controller -n argocd

instruction: How to restart ArgoCD dex server
output: kubectl rollout restart deployment argocd-dex-server -n argocd

instruction: How to check ArgoCD repo-server logs
output: kubectl logs -n argocd deployment/argocd-repo-server --tail=50

instruction: How to check ArgoCD application controller logs
output: kubectl logs -n argocd deployment/argocd-application-controller --tail=50

instruction: How to check ArgoCD server logs
output: kubectl logs -n argocd deployment/argocd-server --tail=50

instruction: How to check ArgoCD dex server logs
output: kubectl logs -n argocd deployment/argocd-dex-server --tail=50

instruction: How to list all ArgoCD applications in a specific project
output: argocd app list --project my-project

instruction: How to list all ArgoCD applications with their sync status
output: argocd app list --output wide

instruction: How to list all ArgoCD applications with JSON output
output: argocd app list -o json

instruction: How to list all ArgoCD applications that are out of sync
output: argocd app list -o json | jq '.[] | select(.status.sync.status != "Synced") | .metadata.name'

instruction: How to list all ArgoCD applications that have health issues
output: argocd app list -o json | jq '.[] | select(.status.health.status != "Healthy") | .metadata.name'

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Helm values
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./charts/my-app --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --helm-set image.tag=v1.0

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Helm value files
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./charts/my-app --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --helm-value-files values-prod.yaml

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize/overlays/prod --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with Kustomize images
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./kustomize --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --kustomize-image myimage:v1.0

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a sync wave
output: argocd app create my-app --sync-wave -1 --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to sync ArgoCD applications in a specific order
output: argocd app sync my-app --sync-wave 1

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with ignore differences
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --ignore-differences 'kind=Deployment,jsonPointers=[/spec/replicas]'

instruction: How to update an ArgoCD application to ignore differences
output: argocd app set my-app --ignore-differences 'kind=HorizontalPodAutoscaler,jsonPointers=[/spec/metrics]'

instruction: How to remove an ignore-difference from an ArgoCD app
output: argocd app set my-app --ignore-differences-

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application with a namespace resource auto-creation
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace my-ns --sync-policy automated --self-heal --auto-prune

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application without namespace
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/user/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default

instruction: How to create an ArgoCD application from a private repo
output: argocd app create my-app --repo https://github.com/private/repo.git --path ./k8s --dest-server https://kubernetes.default.svc --dest-namespace default --upsert
